claims.claim: Legacy session migration encodes cwd exactly like the canonical session directory contract: one leading separator stripped, then every '/', '\\' and ':' replaced with '-', so the migrated file lands under sessions/<canonical>/.
claims.evidence: getDefaultSessionDir(cwd, agentDir) equality, post-migration file location, byte-preserving rename, and SessionManager.findById/list/open discovering the migrated file.

claims.claim: getDefaultSessionDirPath encodes the same character set as the migration producer, so absolute POSIX cwd values containing slashes, backslashes and colons (including Windows-style fragments) resolve to the directory migration writes to.
claims.evidence: Canonical directory equality for three cwd fixtures plus exact-path results from SessionManager.findById and SessionManager.list.

validation.notes: Cross-module regression loads the real src/migrations.ts producer and the real src/core/session-manager.ts reader via .prale-eval/subject.mjs (only external IO boundaries faked). It writes legacy JSONL files directly into the agent dir with headers whose cwd values are absolute POSIX paths containing '/', '\\' and ':' plus Unicode (e.g. /srv/Проект π/C:\Users\Ada Lovelace/unit:42), then asserts: (1) getDefaultSessionDir equals the locally restated canonical encoding for all fixtures; (2) migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot moves each file into sessions/<canonical>/ and removes it from the agent root; (3) migrated bytes are identical, preserving Unicode, entry order and the malformed/blank lines that the reader skips; (4) SessionManager.findById, SessionManager.list (id/path/cwd/messageCount/Unicode firstMessage) and SessionManager.open (getHeader().cwd, getEntries() order/fields) all resolve the migrated file; (5) a pre-existing canonical file is never overwritten and the colliding legacy file is not discarded; (6) two additional migration runs leave the agent-dir tree byte-identical with no new files or directories. Mutation check performed locally (then restored byte-for-byte via sha256): reverting only migrations.ts fails the 'migration wrote ... to the canonical directory' assertion (false !== true); reverting only session-manager.ts fails the canonical directory comparison ('--...C:-Users-...-unit:42--' vs '--...C--Users-...-unit-42--'). Both are uncaught node:assert/strict assertion failures, not import errors, crashes or timeouts. All fixtures live under .prale-eval/tmp and are removed in a finally block. Limitation: node_modules is not installed in this workspace, so repository tsc/vitest/biome checks could not be run; the required Node 24 command is dependency-free, uses no real time/randomness/external services, and passed (exit 0).
